decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful win condition. By efficiently cycling through cards with cantrips like Opt and Gush, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal like Thwart and Chain of Vapor, the deck aims to reach a winning position as fast as possible. The inclusion of cards like Flash of Insight and Peek also adds additional card advantage and selection to help further streamline the combo and control elements of the deck.

The deck revolves around locking down your opponent's resources with the Stasis card while using other supporting cards like Forsaken City and Gush to maintain control of the game. By combining card draw spells with counterspells, the deck aims to consistently prevent the opponent from breaking free of the Stasis lock, ultimately winning the game through either deck out or by leveraging Black Vise for extra damage. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and slowly grind them down until victory is achieved.

The deck focuses on utilizing enchantments to generate card advantage and mana ramp through Enchantress effects. It aims to create a powerful board presence by turning enchantments into creatures with Opalescence and controlling the board with Parallax Wave. Replenish allows the player to bring back multiple enchantments from the graveyard, while Serra's Sanctum provides additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing to deal with threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around creating a synergistic engine with enchantments to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and creature removal. The deck also utilizes card advantage through cards like Wall of Roots and Wall of Blossoms. It aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent by efficiently trading resources. The win condition is typically through slow and steady beats from creatures like Treetop Village and Ravenous Baloth. The deck also has the ability to recur key cards from the graveyard using Genesis and Skeletal Scrying.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize enchantments to control the game and create a strong board presence. By leveraging cards like Sterling Grove, Enchantress's Presence, and Serra's Sanctum, the deck aims to quickly set up a powerful enchantment engine. The combo potential of Opalescence, Parallax Wave, and Replenish allows for devastating plays that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing provide additional removal and control options to deal with threats. The deck's strategy revolves around maximizing the synergy between enchantments to dominate the battlefield.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays using creatures like Ravenous Rats, Nantuko Shade, and Hypnotic Specter. It also disrupts the opponent's strategy with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy, while maintaining card advantage with Graveborn Muse. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict to control the board, while also applying pressure with Mishra's Factory. The inclusion of Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further solidifying this deck's aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat on the battlefield. The deck includes cards like Gush, Foil, Counterspell, and Daze to control the flow of the game and protect the combo. With additional cards like Vision Charm and Portent to manipulate the top of the library, the deck aims to efficiently draw and play the necessary pieces to ensure a successful combo and secure victory in a Premodern 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Mox Diamond and Weathered Wayfarer to play powerful land destruction spells like Armageddon and Terravore. The goal is to disrupt your opponent's mana base while deploying threats like Nimble Mongoose and Werebear to apply pressure. The deck also includes ways to draw cards with Sylvan Library and generate token creatures with Call of the Herd. By combining aggressive creatures with land destruction, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and disrupt their game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and land denial while utilizing the card advantage generated by Standstill. This strategy aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently managing resources and shutting down their game plan. The deck has a strong mana base with a combination of dual lands, fetch lands, and utility lands to ensure consistency and flexibility. The inclusion of powerful control cards like Mana Leak, Counterspell, Swords to Plowshares, and Wrath of God helps to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to use enchantresses to draw cards and generate mana, while using enchantments like Opalescence and Solitary Confinement to control the board and protect yourself. The deck focuses on creating a strong enchantment presence on the battlefield, utilizing cards like Wild Growth and exploration to ramp up mana production. This allows for efficient casting of powerful enchantments like Parallax Wave and Sacred Mesa, ultimately leading to a win condition through overwhelming board presence and control.

This Goblins deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creature plays, using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief to cheat out powerful creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to slow down the opponent's game plan. The goal is to establish a strong board presence early in the game and maintain pressure to secure a quick victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with low-cost creatures like Ramosian Sergeant, Silver Knight, and Whipcorder, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Weathered Wayfarer. The deck also has access to powerful removal spells like Armageddon and Masticore to control the board. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Tithe and Aura of Silence provide additional utility and options for the player. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a consistent stream of threats while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The deck focuses on countering opponent's spells and controlling the board through counterspells, removal, and land denial. The key strategy is to lock down the game with Standstill while using efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God to deal with threats. By controlling the board and denying the opponent lands with cards like Dust Bowl, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage. Additionally, the deck has the flexibility to win through beatdown with Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave or through token generation with Decree of Justice.

The main concept of this deck is to use enchantresses to draw cards whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield. The deck focuses on ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Serra's Sanctum, while controlling the board with enchantments like Seal of Cleansing and Parallax Wave. The combo pieces of Solitary Confinement and Opalescence can create a lockout effect, while cards like Sterling Grove and Replenish help to recur key enchantments. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and powerful enchantments.

The core idea of this deck is to control the game using disruptive spells like Duress, Counterspell, and Foil while building up card advantage with Gush, Accumulated Knowledge, and Opt. Psychatog serves as a win condition that can quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Sickening Dreams to deal with opponent's threats. Tsabo's Web is a unique inclusion to disrupt certain strategies, and Chain of Vapor can be used for tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and grind out a victory through careful resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to disrupt your opponent's plans. The deck aims to deny its opponent resources by making them hesitant to play spells while generating card advantage through cards like Fact or Fiction. The win condition is typically through using lands like Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave as creature threats, as well as resolving a powerful finisher like Exalted Angel. The deck also utilizes the card advantage engine Standstill to gain further advantage.
